3792.title: Command completion leaves a pending Pi settlement
3792.rootCauseOneLine: A handled Pi command resolves RPC preflight without agent_end, leaving BB’s separate run settlement pending.
3792.proposedFix: Provide an explicit per-prompt handled-without-run outcome and settle the matching dispatch; preserve normal preflight and queue behavior.
3792.caveats: Real Pi 0.84.0 provider-session reproduction in two clean trusted checkouts; Pi 0.85.1 and browser follow-up queue not exercised. No PR: safe completion-contract/design work exceeds simple-fix limits. Reproduction test embedded in HTML; raw logs retained locally under report repository publication policy.
